notes.title: Update notes for 7-13
notes.content:
We got a lot of great feedback at DreamHack Dallas and the Southeast Game Exchange. This update addresses two recurring issues: a clearer tutorial for the peer/alter mechanics and landmarks to make navigation easier. 

The creative director will be streaming on Steam tomorrow at 2pm to talk about these changes and our future plans!

notes.title: Update Notes for February 13th
notes.content:
Thank you to all who provided feedback on our first release. 

In response to your comments, we have made the following improvements to the movement system:

[list]
[*] Reducing Nohla's turn radius: She will now pivot 180 degrees when reversing direction.
[*] Wallrunning improvements: Wallrunning is now easier to initiate, and the speed has been reduced to allow easier timing when switching worlds.
[*] Climbing modifications: Nohla can now latch onto climbable surfaces in midair.
[/list]

Other fixes:
[list]
[*] Added saving and loading: After quitting the game, you now have the option to save your progress and continue from your last checkpoint. [u][b]Only one file can be saved at a time.[/b][/u]
[*] Level design tweaks: Due to resource limitations we are not able to make large aesthetic changes to the level, but some building placements have been modified to reduce confusion and frustration when traversing the environment.
[*] Controller support: The game is now fully compatible with a gamepad controller and the Steamdeck.
[*] Camera sensitivity can now be adjusted in the settings menu.
[/list]

We hope that these updates will improve your experience with Project Parallel.

notes.title: Project Parallel Demo Available to Play Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We are Basking Bee Games, a small indie team, and we’ve just dropped our Steam demo for Project Parallel. The game is in development, and we are so excited to what we have so far and hear what you think about the demo. 

[b]About Project Parallel:[/b]

Years after losing her parents at the hands of a totalitarian death cult, vigilante Nohla travels the multiverse foiling their attempts to destroy worlds. But when her latest mission goes awry, she finds herself in two worlds she never wanted to see. When fragments of her parents’ research appear, Nohla must face the past to fight for the future of the multiverse.

[list]
[b][*] Peer to see other worlds before you Alter into them.
[*] Wall run, climb, jump, and world shift to progress to your objective.
[*] Discover family secrets while exploring the worlds.
[*] Sneak past enemies and find out exactly what they’re up too…
[*] And save the multiverse![/b]
[/list]

Play the demo now and let us know what you think about it so far!
